blocks.text: Chilliwack Homes Under $1.8M Real Estate FAQs

parts.t: What types of detached houses are available under $1.8M in Chilliwack?

Under $1.8 million covers most detached single-family homes in Chilliwack, including entry-level detached houses in Chilliwack Proper ($675K–$875K), 3- to 5-bedroom family houses and ranchers in Sardis, Garrison Crossing, and Fairfield Island ($850K–$1.25M), and newer hillside view homes or small acreages in Promontory, Eastern Hillsides, Yarrow, and Rosedale ($1.15M–$1.79M).
Which Chilliwack neighbourhoods have detached houses with basement suites?

Two-storey and basement-entry homes with 1- or 2-bedroom suites are especially common in Promontory, Eastern Hillsides, Sardis South, Sardis East Vedder, Garrison Crossing, and newer infill pockets of Chilliwack Proper.
Where can I find detached houses on 7,500+ sq ft flat lots with workshop or RV parking?

Fairfield Island, Rosedale, Yarrow, Greendale, and older streets in Sardis East/West Vedder and Chilliwack Proper East are the primary areas for wider flat lots that accommodate detached shops and RV parking.
Are there hillside or flood construction rules for Chilliwack houses?

Yes. Hillside areas (Promontory, Little Mountain, Chilliwack Mountain, Eastern Hillsides, Vedder Mountain, Majuba Hill, and Ryder Lake) fall under Development Permit Area 2 (geotechnical and slope rules), while valley-floor parcels near the Fraser or Vedder Rivers are governed by City Floodplain Regulation Bylaws.
What schools serve Sardis vs. north-side Chilliwack homes?

Within School District 33 (SD33), south-side neighbourhoods (Sardis, Garrison Crossing, Vedder, Promontory, Yarrow) generally feed into Sardis Secondary or G.W. Graham Secondary, while north-side neighbourhoods (Chilliwack Proper, Downtown, Fairfield Island, Little Mountain) feed into Chilliwack Secondary. Always confirm exact catchment by street address on the SD33 School Locator.
Are there leasehold detached homes in Chilliwack under $1.8M?

Yes. While most detached homes in Chilliwack are freehold (fee simple), communities such as Cedarbrook in Lower Landing (Shxwhá:y Village lands), Cultus Lake Park, and certain gated Sardis subdivisions are leasehold. Always verify title type on the MLS® sheet before offering.
How is Property Transfer Tax calculated on a Chilliwack house under $1.8M?

In BC, general Property Transfer Tax is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% on the portion between $200,000 and $2,000,000, and 3% above $2,000,000. Newly built homes up to $1.1M qualify for the Newly Built Home PTT exemption for eligible principal-residence buyers.
